**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. Fixed in [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6), old name still works.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. Unset now means off. Fixed in [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are pure noise. `build.js` prints them unconditionally, and they name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, unless you want those warning lines pulled out of `build.js`.
